Frozen Thyme and Pear Margarita
By: Ben Myhre
Published: Thursday, July 26, 2018 - 1:16pm

Ingredients




2.5 cups ice
1/2 cup tequila blanco
1/4 cup Cointreau
2 oz simple syrup
6 medium sprigs of thyme leaves, cleaned (plus 2 sprigs for garnish)
1 Ounce of Lime Juice from approximately 1 fresh lime
sugar for rimming
1 pear, cored

Preparation

1 add ice, tequila, Cointreau, simple syrup, lime juice, and thyme leaves to the blender 2 moisten margarita glasses with spent lime and rim with sugar 3 Blend ingredients and add pear intermittently to blend into the margarita 4 Once completely blended, pour into margarita glasses, garnish, and serve

About

A new Margarita recipe that tastes absolutely divine! This Frozen Pear & Thyme Margarita perfectly pairs with a hot Summer day. This blender drink is cool, yummy, and has all of the great flavors of a classic margarita... kicked up a notch. Pears are such a great fruit and putting it into a cocktail such as a margarita just accentuates the awesomeness. Thyme is such a good partner for the pear and putting them together into an adult cocktail is perfect. Give this drink a try!
